package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"strings"

	index "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/decl/pages/index"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/components/box"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/components/ping"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/components/pong"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/components/slow"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/components/tree"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/pages/index"
	_ "example.com/blog/lyr_gen/impl/pages/sub"
	"github.com/orbit-z/lyr"
)

func main() {
	// Under NewWriter, server:concurrent renders inline.
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	if err := index.Render(&lyr.Ctx{URL: &url.URL{Path: "/"}}, lyr.NewWriter(&buf), index.Props{}, lyr.Slots{}); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	inline := strings.Replace(buf.String(), "</head>", `<link rel="stylesheet" href="/x.css"></head>`, 1)

	// Through a Site, the marked components run in their goroutines.
	dir, _ := os.MkdirTemp("", "lyr-conc")
	defer os.RemoveAll(dir)
	site := lyr.NewSite([]lyr.Route{{
		Pattern: "/", File: "src/pages/index.lyr",
		Render: func(c *lyr.Ctx, w *lyr.Writer) error { return index.Render(c, w, index.Props{}, lyr.Slots{}) },
		Assets: []lyr.Asset{{Kind: "css", URL: "/x.css"}},
	}}, nil, lyr.WithStaticDir(dir))
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	site.Handler().ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/", nil))
	fmt.Println(rec.Body.String())
	fmt.Println("same as inline:", rec.Body.String() == inline)
}
